set: Professional photograph of a cooking show studio set designed as a warm, inviting Italian home kitchen, empty, no people. Front view, eye level, symmetrical composition. In the foreground a large kitchen island with a thick light oak worktop and cream painted cabinet front; built into the island on the left a black glass induction cooktop with a copper sauté pan and a copper pot, and on the right a wooden chopping board with ripe red tomatoes on the vine, a bunch of fresh basil, a head of garlic, a bottle of olive oil and a ceramic bowl of fresh pasta dusted with flour. Behind the island, the back wall: cream painted wooden cabinets, a wall of white glossy metro tiles, a long brass rail with hanging copper pans and wooden spoons and ladles, two open oak shelves with glass jars of pasta, beans and spices and a few cookbooks, a large window on the right with potted basil, rosemary and parsley on the sill and soft morning daylight, a small round brass pendant lamp. Colour palette: cream, warm oak, copper, tomato red and basil green accents. Warm cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, highly detailed, no text, no logos.
